'''Indulata L. Sukla''' (7 March 1944 – 30 June 2022)<ref>{{cite news |url=https://odishabytes.com/retd-sambalpur-university-math-prof-indulata-sukla-passes-away/ |title=Retd Sambalpur University Math Prof Indulata Sukla Passes Away |newspaper=odishabytes |date=1 July 2022 |access-date=1 July 2022}}</ref> was an Indian academic, who was professor of mathematics for more than three decades at [[Sambalpur University]], [[Sambalpur]], Odisha.

She did her schooling from Maharani Prem Kumari Girls’ School and B.Sc. with Mathematics Honours from M.P.C. College, Baripada. She completed her M.Sc. in Mathematics from Ravenshaw College, Cuttack in 1966, and had a brief stint as a lecturer in M.P.C. College,{{citation needed|date=July 2015}} before moving to the University of Jabalpur with a CSIR Fellowship to pursue Ph.D. under the supervision of Tribikram Pati.<ref name="pioneer"/> While pursuing her researches, she joined Sambalpur University in November 1970 as a lecturer in the School of Mathematical Sciences, and continued there till her retirement in March 2004.{{citation needed|date=July 2015}}

She is the author of the textbook ''Number Theory and Its Applications to Cryptography'' (Cuttack: Kalyani Publishers, 2000).<ref name="pioneer"/><ref name="nix"/>
In her research, she worked with English mathematician [[Brian Kuttner]] on Fourier Series.<ref name="pioneer"/>{{sfnp|Kuttner|Sukla|1985}}
<!---not listed on IMU page http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByCongress.php---She has presented papers at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Kyoto, Japan (1990), Zurich, Switzerland (1994), Beijing, China (2002) and Hyderabad, India (2010).---> 
She was a Life Member of the [[American Mathematical Society]] (AMS) and the Indian Mathematical Society (IMS).{{citation needed|date=July 2017}}

==Awards and honours==
The Orissa Mathematical Society (OMS) gave her the Lifetime Achievement Award for her work in Number Theory, Cryptography and Analysis. She received the award from Professor Ramachandran Balasubramanian, Director of the Institute of Mathematical Sciences, Chennai at the 42nd Annual Conference of OMS held at Vyasanagar Autonomous College, Jajpur Road, Orissa on 7 February 2015.<ref name="pioneer">{{citation|url=http://www.dailypioneer.com/state-editions/bhubaneswar/mathematician-indulata-sukla-honoured.html|newspaper=[[The Pioneer (India)|The Pioneer]]|title=Mathematician Indulata Sukla Honoured|date=9 February 2015}}.</ref><ref name="nix">{{citation|url=http://www.newindianexpress.com/states/odisha/Mathematician-Awarded-for-Number-Theory/2015/02/09/article2659987.ece|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150725180217/http://www.newindianexpress.com/states/odisha/Mathematician-Awarded-for-Number-Theory/2015/02/09/article2659987.ece|url-status=dead|archive-date=25 July 2015|newspaper=[[The New Indian Express]]|date=9 February 2015|title=Mathematician Awarded for Number Theory}}.</ref>
